Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for JPCH Delhi Junior Resident (MBBS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized University and have valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is between Rs. 56100 to Rs. 177500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a regular or ad-hoc appointment?
faq.answer: This is an ad-hoc appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital located?
faq.answer: Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital is located in Delhi, with a pincode of 110053.
